body:
Redline round 3

Final nit pass: reviewed only the nit fixes (8ddffc7..4d84e3a) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 2 fix changes the checker-text warning in judge() from "on a passing gate" to "on a round that passes". That now matches R1-3's decision, which lets the warning fire when the gate exited 1 only on checks that were already failing at baseline. Both loop-test checks that pin the text were updated in the same commit, and the standards bullet records the lesson. The change adds no correctness bugs: no code branches on the warning string, and no other caller matches it.

No findings.
